from fontTools.ttLib import TTFont
import os, glob

fonts_dir = r''$FONTS_DIR''
# Manually list the TTF files
ttf_files = [
    os.path.join\(fonts_dir, ''Instrument_Serif'', ''InstrumentSerif-Regular.ttf''\),
    os.path.join\(fonts_dir, ''STIX_Two_Text'', ''STIXTwoText-Italic-VariableFont_wght.ttf''\),
    os.path.join\(fonts_dir, ''STIX_Two_Text'', ''STIXTwoText-Italic.ttf''\),
    os.path.join\(fonts_dir, ''Inter'', ''Inter-VariableFont_opsz,wght.ttf''\),
    os.path.join\(fonts_dir, ''Pinyon_Script'', ''PinyonScript-Regular.ttf''\),
]

for ttf_path in ttf_files:
    woff2_path = ttf_path.rsplit\(''.'', 1\)[0] + ''.woff2''
    print\(f''Converting: {os.path.basename\(ttf_path\)} -> {os.path.basename\(woff2_path\)}''\)
    font = TTFont\(ttf_path\)
    font.flavor = ''woff2''
    font.save\(woff2_path\)
    font.close\(\)
    ttf_size = os.path.getsize\(ttf_path\)
    woff2_size = os.path.getsize\(woff2_path\)
    ratio = \(1 - woff2_size/ttf_size\) * 100
    print\(f''  {ttf_size:,} bytes -> {woff2_size:,} bytes \({ratio:.1f}% smaller\)''\)

print\(''Done! All fonts converted.''\)
")
